release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.29 re-establishes the exact v0.45.27 shell and visual baseline, then adds only the requested scoped improvements. Tasks keeps the existing Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, and Amazon retailer modules and now presents a retailer-to-drop-group-to-task hierarchy below them. Members can create and delete retailer-scoped drop groups, start or stop a selected group, search its tasks, and manage individual tasks; deleting a group moves its tasks to Ungrouped and never deletes them. Fleet Control is retired from the visible product while its compatible backend task operations remain intact. The release restores semantic color to real icons and artwork, restores the persistent Member announcements surface immediately at startup, fixes optional-node startup writes that could produce a bottom-right Cannot set properties of null error, adds compact accessible icon-led Top and Sidebar tabs without repainting the shell, and limits the graphite/blue redesign to the Update Available modal. No global root palette, pane repaint, navigation recolor, or second theme authority is introduced.
